methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 verified models spanning freezer-bowl, compressor, pre-frozen-pint (Ninja CREAMi), and stand-mixer-attachment types across price tiers, from the budget Hamilton Beach 68330N to the premium Lello 4080 Musso Lussino. Primary sources are manufacturer pages (Cuisinart, SharkNinja, Whynter, Breville, KitchenAid, Nostalgia) plus major retail listings (Target, Walmart, Williams Sonoma, Sur La Table, HomElectrical, Staples, Goods Store) and technical references. Capacity is in quarts (qt); wattage is watts. Booleans are true only when the feature is explicitly documented. For Ninja CREAMi models, type is 'pre_frozen_pint' (not compressor) because they shave a pre-frozen pint via Creamify Technology rather than refrigerate; build_in_compressor is false and capacity_qt reflects combined pint fill volume. Adversarial re-verification (2026-06-20) corrected: ICE-21P1 wattage 60->50W (manufacturer+Target state 50; 60 only on a B2B reseller); ICE-100 wattage null->288W (Target spec table); Ninja NC301/NC501 type compressor->pre_frozen_pint; Nostalgia ICMP400WD price 129.99->59.99 (actual Walmart price); replaced a dead Breville corroboration URL (therisk.global 404) and a wrong KitchenAid source URL (claimed '8-Quart Mixers' — the KICA0WH explicitly excludes 7/8-qt models). accessedAt 2026-06-20.
